dedupe_keys.name: operational management and spoiled food waste flows at the port of cotonou benin 2020 2023

description: A University of Abomey-Calavi research team publishes operational records for spoiled-food and other goods destroyed at the Port of Cotonou, Benin. Zenodo provides an Excel workbook and R analysis script under CC BY 4.0. Four workbook sheets describe 36 monthly flow observations for 2020–2022, 52 commodity types and disposal modes, and individual operations from 2022–2023. The source reports 2,353.3 tonnes destroyed over the active period. These data can inform port waste-capacity and food-supply disruption simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this operating record. Coverage is one licensed operator and one port programme; company identity and commercially sensitive fields were removed from the public version. A limitation is that monthly destruction flows are not total imports, total spoilage or all port waste. The workbook was not downloaded, so its cells, missingness and the reported total were not independently checked.
